Mariamercedes Palma' in PDF); cron webhook 401 w/o auth, wrong bearer, raw secret w/o 'Bearer'; 200 {status:accepted, fecha:2026-11-12} in ~0.15s with correct secret; background send logged 'Cierre de producción (Dra. Palma) 2026-11-12 enviado: 1 ok, 0 errores, total 0' with httpx 202 Accepted. PDF endpoint: 404 for garbage/tampered-date/wrong-secret/expired tokens, 422 missing token, 200 application/pdf for valid token. Empty day 2020-01-01 -> valid PDF with 'Sin producción registrada' and Q 0.00. Combined aggregation with Mongo-inserted clinic venta (total 111) + optica sale status=pagado (items_v2 frame 200 + lens_type 100, total 300): PDF showed all 3 item rows, both sale numbers, Ventas: 2, TOTAL Q 411.00; after setting optica status=cancelado: optica rows gone, clinic remains, total Q 111.00. Test docs cleaned (verified 0 remaining). Manual send: 401/403 unauthenticated, 403 for 'usuario' role. Regression: GET /api/ventas/analisis 200 (superadmin); anesthesia cron 401 w/o auth and 200 + emails sent with auth. crons.yml entry 'produccion-palma' valid (0 17 * * *, America/Guatemala, {{BASE_URL}}/api/cron/produccion-medico-diario, POST, enabled).

minor.issue: Leftover copy-paste code at end of file: after logger.error(...) inside the except block there is a stray `logger.info(f"Informe de anestesia ... {resultado['resumen']['total_count']} ...")` plus a duplicate unreachable `except Exception` clause. If enviar_informe_produccion_medico_diario raises, the except block will then raise UnboundLocalError/NameError on `resultado` (and 'total_count' key does not exist in produccion resumen). Delete lines 630-632.

No retry/backoff on email provider 429. When I fired produccion + anestesia crons back-to-back, anesthesia 2nd recipient got 'HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests' (1 ok, 1 error). Scheduled times differ (17:00 vs 18:00) so Palma is unaffected, but cierre-diario and informe-anestesia both run at 18:00 and could collide. Consider small delay/retry on 429.

Total del día uses venta.total (incl. IVA/discounts for clinic) while row 'Monto' uses item subtotal (pre-IVA), so rows don't sum to the total for real clinic sales (e.g. item 150 vs total 168). Matches spec, but may confuse the doctor; consider a note or IVA row.
